waivers.reason: Draft badge: v2 content-status marker; the original had no draft concept.
Identifiers row (Wikidata, QUDT): v2 data the original never carried.
Learning-path context bar: learning paths do not exist in the original.
Per-term unit pickers: the original calculator had fixed SI units per input.
Generated-unit line: prefixed units are generated in v2 (ADR 0007); the original had none.
Result-format setting: the original always printed calculator results in full-precision scientific notation, with no choice.

Raw TeX in table cells: the original prints the unit symbols as TeX source ($J$, $kg$, $\frac{m}{s}$) because its tables render after the MathJax pass; the port typesets them at build time. The wider source strings change the auto table layout, so every column of both term cards shifts, and through flex min-content so does the split of the card row.

Raw TeX in table cells: the original calculator prints the unit symbols of its term tables as TeX source ($J$, $kg$) because the tables render after the MathJax pass; the port typesets them at build time. The wider source strings change the auto table layout, so every column of the term table shifts.
